text.p: Typhoon Beth, with 80 mph winds, is approaching northern Luzon, Philippines, from the east as it tracks west near 12 mph. Top winds may reach 90 mph before landfall along the upper east coast of Luzon in about 12 hours. A storm surge just ahead of and to the north of the storm center will create coastal flooding. Wind damage is likely. Flooding and mudslides are likely over inland locations from heavy rain, which will last through Friday. Beth will weaken as it travels westward across Luzon, but will likely reintensify when it enters the South China Sea, west of Luzon, where it will be a threat to shipping.

Lili, a strong tropical storm, threatens Cuba and eventually southern Florida... Hurricane warnings are up for the Isle of Youth and the western mainland provinces of Pinar Del Rio, Havana, Matanzas, Villa Clara, and Cienfuegos in Cuba. Tropical storm warnings are in effect for the east coast of the Yucatan Peninsula from Cabo Catoche southward to Bahia De Chetumal, and the Cayman Islands - which may be discontinued today. Lili has top winds near 65 mph and is 325 miles south southwest of Havana, Cuba, drifitn north. This motion will continue today, bringing the center near western Cuba tonight. Lili may become a hurricane later today.

Tropical Storm Lili is expected to produce rainfall amounts of locally 6-12 inches over western and central Cuba where flooding could be major. Heavy rains are also possible over portions of eastern Central America and the Yucatan early this period. By Friday, Lili will become an increased threat to the Florida Keys, when it may approach the region as a hurricane. Shipping will also be threatened throughout the region.
